title: Operations & HR Administrator
description:
Part-Time 18 Hours per Week 3 Days per Week 9:00am - 3:00pm

Are you an organised and proactive administrator who enjoys supporting people and keeping a busy business running smoothly?

Our client is a growing and ambitious business seeking an Operations & HR Administrator to join their head office team on a part-time basis. This is a varied and rewarding opportunity for someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment and enjoys balancing people-focused responsibilities with operational administration.

Working closely with senior leadership, you will play a key role in supporting recruitment, employee administration, payroll preparation, compliance activities and the day-to-day coordination of business operations.

The Role

This is a diverse position where no two days are the same. Responsibilities will include:
- Coordinating recruitment administration and candidate communications.
- Preparing employment contracts and onboarding documentation.
- Supporting new starter onboarding processes.
- Maintaining accurate employee records and personnel files.
- Preparing payroll information for processing.
- Managing holiday, absence and employee administration records.
- Maintaining compliance and business documentation.
- Providing general administrative support across the wider business.
- Assisting with operational projects and ad hoc administrative tasks.

About You

We are looking for an individual who is:
- Highly organised with excellent attention to detail.
- Reliable, professional and able to maintain confidentiality.
- Comfortable managing multiple priorities and deadlines.
- Confident communicating with colleagues at all levels.
- Self-motivated and capable of working independently.
- Proactive in identifying improvements and solving problems.
- Passionate about supporting a growing and evolving business.

Previous experience within administration, HR support, office coordination or business support would be advantageous; however, attitude, organisation and a willingness to learn are equally important.

What's on Offer?
- Part-time position, 18 hours per week.
- Three-day working week.
- Fixed working pattern of 9:00am to 3:00pm.
- A varied role with exposure to people, operations and business administration.
- Opportunity to make a genuine impact within a growing organisation.
- Supportive and collaborative working environment.
- Long-term opportunity to develop alongside the business.

If you are a highly organised administrator who enjoys bringing structure, efficiency and support to a busy operation, we would love to hear from you.

title: Bookkeeper
description:
Hereford Full-Time £32,000-£36,000 FTE

The Opportunity

An established multi-site business is seeking a highly organised and experienced Book-Keeper / Senior Finance Assistant to join its Head Office finance team.

This is a hands-on position responsible for ensuring the smooth day-to-day running of the transactional finance function. The successful candidate will play a key role in maintaining accurate financial records, supporting month-end activities and ensuring finance processes are completed accurately and efficiently.

This opportunity offers flexibility, with both full-time and part-time applicants considered. For this organisation, finding the right individual is more important than a rigid working pattern.

In addition to managing the transactional finance workload, you will take responsibility for coordinating and supporting a junior member of the team, helping to create an efficient, well-organised and collaborative finance function.

Key Responsibilities
- Managing purchase ledger activities and supplier invoice processing.
- Ensuring accurate coding of expenditure and financial transactions.
- Completing supplier statement reconciliations.
- Performing bank and account reconciliations.
- Resolving invoice discrepancies, supplier queries and credit note issues.
- Preparing payment runs and maintaining payment schedules.
- Maintaining accurate supplier and financial records.
- Ensuring all transactional processing is completed in a timely manner to support month-end deadlines.
- Liaising with external finance partners and internal stakeholders.
- Identifying opportunities to improve finance processes and controls.
- Supporting the implementation of more efficient systems and ways of working.
- Coordinating the day-to-day workload of a junior finance team member.
- Delegating tasks effectively and monitoring completion.
- Providing guidance, support and ongoing development to less experienced colleagues.

About You

We are looking for an individual who combines strong accounts experience with excellent organisation and communication skills.

You will ideally have:
- Previous bookkeeping, purchase ledger or accounts administration experience.
- Strong understanding of transactional finance processes.
- Excellent attention to detail and accuracy.
- The ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines consistently.
- Confidence in reviewing work and providing support to junior colleagues.
- Strong communication and relationship-building skills.
- Experience using accounting software and Excel.
- A proactive approach to problem-solving and process improvement.
- High levels of professionalism, discretion and accountability.

Experience within a multi-site business environment would be advantageous but is not essential.

What's on Offer?
- Salary of £32,000-£36,000 FTE, depending on experience.
- Full-time or part-time working options available.
- Minimum commitment of three days per week.
- A varied and autonomous role with genuine responsibility.
- Opportunity to help shape and improve finance processes.
- Supportive and collaborative working environment.
- Long-term career development within a growing organisation.

If you are an organised finance professional who enjoys taking ownership, improving processes and supporting others to succeed, we would be delighted to hear from you.

title: Personal Assistant
description:
Personal Assistant to Managing Director
Location: Hereford
Salary: Up to £35,000 per annum
Working Pattern: Full-time, Monday to Friday, 5 days on-site
Employment Type: Permanent
The Opportunity We're recruiting for a Personal Assistant to support the Managing Director of a growing IT Services business based in Hereford.
Our client is an established technology services provider continuing to expand its customer base and operations. As the business grows, they're looking for an organised, proactive and commercially aware PA who can work closely with the MD, helping manage their workload, coordinate business activities and ensure day-to-day operations run smoothly.
This is more than a traditional administrative position. You'll become a trusted point of contact for the MD, helping manage competing priorities, supporting business projects and ensuring important actions are followed through.
It's an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys taking ownership, working independently and being involved in different areas of a growing business.
Key Responsibilities
- Provide comprehensive PA and administrative support to the Managing Director.
- Manage diaries, meetings, appointments and travel arrangements, ensuring the MD's time is used effectively.
- Act as a key point of contact for internal teams, customers and external stakeholders.
- Manage correspondence, emails and communications on behalf of the MD.
- Prepare reports, presentations, meeting agendas and business documentation.
- Coordinate meetings, capture actions and follow up with relevant stakeholders to ensure deadlines are met.
- Support the coordination of internal projects and wider business improvement initiatives.
- Assist with confidential business information, commercial documentation and administrative processes.
- Work closely with department managers to coordinate priorities and improve communication across the business.
- Identify opportunities to improve administrative processes and support the continued growth of the organisation.

What We're Looking For
- Previous experience as a Personal Assistant, Executive Assistant, Office Manager or in a similar senior administrative role.
- Experience supporting a Managing Director, senior leader or management team.
- Excellent organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and competing deadlines.
- Strong written and verbal communication skills, with confidence engaging with stakeholders at all levels.
- Good working knowledge of Microsoft Office, including Outlook, Excel, Word and PowerPoint.
- A proactive approach, with the confidence to work independently and take ownership of tasks.
- Strong attention to detail and the ability to handle confidential information professionally.
- Comfortable working in a growing business where priorities can change quickly.

Experience within IT Services, Managed Services or another technical environment would be advantageous, although this isn't essential.
Why Consider This Opportunity?
- Work directly with the Managing Director of a growing technology business.
- Gain exposure to business operations, commercial activities and strategic projects.
- Take ownership of a varied role with genuine responsibility.
- Join an established organisation with ambitious plans for continued growth.
- Opportunity to develop the position as the business expands.

Interested? If you're an experienced PA or EA looking for a varied position where you can make a genuine difference to a growing business, we'd be keen to hear from you.
Salary up to £35,000 Hereford Full-time, office-based
Apply today or contact IMT Resourcing for a confidential discussion.

title: Accounts Assistant - Hybrid
description:
Exciting opportunity in Ross-on-Wye for an Accounts Assistant to join an active and busy accounts function in a nationally recognised company in a full time role.

You will support the Accounts Payable and Accounts Receivable function, assisting with supplier payments, bank reconciliations, credit control, customer and supplier queries, and maintaining accurate financial records. Full training on company process and systems provided.

- Process supplier invoices accurately and within deadlines.
- Support supplier payment runs and maintain supplier accounts.
- Reconcile supplier statements and resolve invoice or payment queries.
- Process daily banking transactions and complete bank reconciliations.
- Assist with month-end journals and financial reconciliations.
- Support credit control by monitoring aged debt and chasing overdue payments.
- Respond to customer and supplier queries in a professional manner.
- Maintain accurate financial records, documentation and account data.
- Work with colleagues to identify and support process improvements.

Key Attributes
- Previous finance or accounts experience essential
- Reliable, team player

Salary: £12.92 - £14.36 per hour + benefits including:
- Hybrid working
- Free parking
- EAP Programme.
- 25 days holiday PLUS bank holidays + annual leave purchase scheme (pro rata for temp)
- Birthday day off.

title: Project Administrator

Project Administrator

28,000 + Training + Progression + Benefits

Ross-on-Wye (Commutable from: Hereford, Ledbury, Coleford, Gloucester, Cheltenham, Lydney, Abergavenny, Worcester and surrounding areas)

title: Medical Administrator
description: We currently have full-time and part-time vacancies for medical administrators. Our working hours are 0800hrs to 1800hrs. We are seeking a reliable, organised and detail-focused individuals to join our administration team. This post is primarily office based and focuses on the accurate processing, management and administration of patient information and practice documentation, rather than direct front of house reception duties. The post holder will support clinicians and the wider practice team by ensuring that all incoming correspondence, electronic communications and patient records are handled efficiently, confidentially and in line with practice policies and procedures. Although the role does not involve routine face to face contact with patients, it does require professionalism, discretion and the occasional need to contact patients, hence a clear understanding of the importance of confidentiality and data is required. Interviews to be held 15th December 2026 Job Summary: Ensure that all contacts from patients and third parties, over the telephone and electronically, are greeted in a friendly helpful manner and handled courteously, efficiently and confidentially at all times. Ensure that all requests and enquiries are handled courteously, efficiently and in line with practice policies and procedures. Ensure that the filing and recording of patient information both electronic and manual is promptly handled with care and in line with practice policies and procedures. Help to ensure that the surgery premises are kept safe and tidy at all times. Support the clinicians in their role. Alert a supervisor or manager to any problems or concerns from staff or patients when necessary. Provide general assistance to the practice team and project a positive and friendly image to patients and other visitors, either in person or via the telephone. Please see the attached Job Description and Person Specification for further information regarding this role. If you have any further questions or wish to arrange an informal discussion regarding this role, please don't hesitate to get in touch.
